# x-widgets-antdv

> Vue 3 components and schema-driven business widgets based on Ant Design Vue 4.

- Package: `x-widgets-antdv` (MIT)
- Runtime: Vue 3.5+, Ant Design Vue 4.x, `@ant-design/icons-vue` 7.x; Vue Router 4.x is required by `GoBack`.
- Install: `npm install x-widgets-antdv vue ant-design-vue @ant-design/icons-vue vue-router`
- Styles: `ant-design-vue/dist/reset.css` and `x-widgets-antdv/style.css`.
- Public API: named exports from the package root; do not deep-import source paths.

## Grounding rules

- `SearchForm` and other schema widgets receive host-owned form data; this library does not implement application API requests.
- Use `ColumnForFormItemType` for Ant Design Vue package form fields; verify wrapper-specific props in source declarations.
- `Table` forwards Ant Design Vue table contracts and adds only the wrapper props documented in the table guide.
- The default plugin only registers exports with an `install` method; named imports are the reliable selective-registration path.
- Do not assume compatibility with the Element Plus package or translate framework-specific props without checking target types.
